Title: Imibhalo lencane yemidlalo
Subtitle: Humusha imibhalo lephansi yesiNgisi kusuka ku-PS5 yakho ku-OBS.
ConnectHint: Engeza script esimeni sakho semdlalo kanye.
TestHint: Zama umugca wesampula ngaphambi kwekutsi uxhume ikhonsoli.
SelectHint: Dvweba libhokisi lelizungeze imibhalo lephansi yesiNgisi kuhlaka lwemdlalo.
AreaReady: Indzawo yesihloko lesincane igcinwe. Vula ikhamera lebonakalako ye-OBS.
Help: Khetsa indzawo yakho yemdlalo ku-OBS. Vula Emathulusi → Imibhalo bese uchafata +. Namatsisela indlela ye-script bese uvula ifayela. Chafata inkinobho kusethingi ye-script kute wengete imibhalo lencane kulendzawo. Buyela ku SubZir bese uhlola kuhumusha.
Checking: Kufundza umugca wesampula kanye nekuhlola uxhumano lwe-OBS...
TestSuccess: OBS utfole umugca wesampula. Hlola indzawo yayo kulendzawo.
TestNoAck: Kuhumusha kwaphumelela, kepha i-OBS ayizange ikucinisekise. Khetsa umdlalo wakho bese uphindza sinyatselo 1.
Waiting: Kulindzelwe imibhalo lephansi yesiNgisi levela kukhamera ye-OBS...
OcrMissing: Faka kubonwa kwembhalo wesiNgisi ku-Windows. Bona umhlahlandlela kute utfole ticondziso.
CheckCamera: Hlola ikhamera lebonakalako bese ukhetsa indzawo yesihloko lesincane futsi.
TestFailed: Lesivivinyo asizange siphele. Vula Kucatulula Tinkinga kulesicondziso.
TestEmpty: Kute umugca wesampula lowatfolakala. Yetama lesivivinyo futsi.
GettingFrame: Kutfola luhlaka kusuka kukhamera lebonakalako ye-OBS...
NoFrame: Kute luhlaka lolutfoliwe. Ku-OBS, cala ikhamera lebonakalako bese uphindza sinyatselo 3.
LaunchError: Khipha yonkhe i-ZIP ku-Documents bese uyazama futsi.
Picker: Dvweba libhokisi lelitungelete lendzawo umugca munye noma lemibili yesihloko lesincane
GuideBody: Nika emandla imibhalo lephansi yesiNgisi emdlalweni wakho. Xhuma ikhadi lokubamba ku OBS. Faka umbhalo wesihloko lesincane esimeni semdlalo. Setha umphumela wekhamera lebonakalako kumtfombo welikhadi lekubamba bese ucala ikhamera lebonakalako. Ku-SubZir, khetsa indzawo yesihloko lesincane bese ucala kuhumusha.
AddScene: Ngeta imibhalo lephansi kulendzawo lekhona nyalo
ModelError: Imodeli yekuhumusha ayikwatanga kucedza lesicelo. Bona sikhatsi sekugijima/kuhlola.txt.
